## Shared contracts (revision 2, 2026-11-08 21:35: approved libraries added; signatures unchanged)

### OpenTextKit (W1) — library `OpenTextKit`, executables `opentext`, `opentext-mcp`; macOS 26; Swift 6 language mode
```swift
public enum DocFormat: String, CaseIterable, Codable, Sendable {
    case txt, md, rtf, html, docx, doc, odt, csv, json, pdf, png, jpg, heic, tiff, gif, webp, otlock
    public init?(url: URL)                      // by extension, case-insensitive; "jpeg"→jpg, "markdown"→md, "htm"→html
    public var fileExtension: String
    public var isText: Bool; public var isImage: Bool
}
public struct ConversionOptions: Sendable { public var overwrite = false; public var imageQuality = 0.9; public var ocr = true; public init() }
public enum OpenTextError: Error, LocalizedError, Equatable {
    case unsupportedConversion(from: DocFormat, to: DocFormat), unreadable(URL), writeFailed(URL),
         wrongPassword, corruptLockedFile, notLocked, noRecoveryKeyConfigured, invalidRecoveryKey
}
public struct ConversionEngine: Sendable {
    public init()
    public func targets(from: DocFormat) -> [DocFormat]
    /// Writes next to the input unless `output` is given. Never overwrites unless options.overwrite;
    /// picks "name 2.ext", "name 3.ext"… Returns the written URL(s) (pdf→png returns one per page).
    public func convert(_ input: URL, to: DocFormat, output: URL? = nil, options: ConversionOptions = .init()) throws -> [URL]
    public func extractText(_ input: URL, ocr: Bool = true) throws -> String
    public func combinePDFs(_ inputs: [URL], output: URL) throws -> URL
    public func imagesToPDF(_ inputs: [URL], output: URL) throws -> URL
    /// Changes format in place for the title-bar chip: converts, then moves the original to the Trash.
    public func switchFormat(_ input: URL, to: DocFormat) throws -> URL
}
public enum NewFile { public static func create(_ format: DocFormat, name: String = "Untitled", in folder: URL) throws -> URL } // txt, md, csv, html; unique name
public struct RecoveryKey: Sendable {          // Curve25519 key agreement keypair; private part shown to Walker once
    public static func generate() -> (key: RecoveryKey, publicKeyBase64: String)
    public init?(displayString: String)        // tolerant of spaces/dashes/case
    public var displayString: String           // base32, groups of 4 separated by "-"
}
public enum Locker {
    public static func lock(_ input: URL, password: String, recoveryPublicKeyBase64: String?, output: URL? = nil, removeOriginal: Bool = false) throws -> URL
    public static func unlock(_ input: URL, password: String, output: URL? = nil) throws -> URL
    public static func unlock(_ input: URL, recoveryKey: RecoveryKey, output: URL? = nil) throws -> URL
    public static func decrypt(_ input: URL, password: String) throws -> (data: Data, originalName: String)
    public static func isLocked(_ url: URL) -> Bool
}
public struct OpenTextSettings: Codable, Sendable {  // ~/Library/Application Support/OpenText/settings.json, plain editable JSON
    public var defaultFolder: String = "~/Desktop"
    public var hotkey: String = "ctrl+opt+n"
    public var recoveryPublicKey: String? = nil
    public var useTouchID: Bool = true
    public var txtMonospace: Bool = false
    public var lastNewFileFormat: String = "md"
    public static func load() -> OpenTextSettings; public func save() throws
    public static var fileURL: URL
}
```

### .otlock format (W1 documents it in docs/build/otlock-format.md)
Magic `OTLK`, version byte 1, then a JSON header length + JSON header, then ciphertext.
- Random 256-bit file key. Payload = AES-256-GCM(file key) over `original name (UTF-8, length-prefixed) + original bytes`.
- Password slot: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (CommonCrypto), 600,000 iterations, 16-byte salt → key-encryption key → AES-GCM wraps the file key.
- Recovery slot (when a recovery public key is configured): ephemeral Curve25519 key agreement with the recovery public key → HKDF-SHA256 → AES-GCM wraps the file key.
- Header stores iterations, salts, nonces, wrapped keys (base64). Format is fully specified so it can be decrypted without the app.

### CLI and MCP (W1 documents in docs/build/cli-mcp.md)
CLI: `opentext convert <files…> --to <fmt> [--out <path>] [--overwrite]`, `text <file> [--no-ocr]`, `new <fmt> [name] [--in <dir>]`, `combine <pdfs…> --out <file>`, `images-to-pdf <images…> --out <file>`, `lock <file> [--remove-original]`, `unlock <file> [--recovery-key <key>]`, `formats [<fmt>]`; `--json` on every command. Password from `OPENTEXT_PASSWORD` or a no-echo prompt. Exit 0 / 1 with message on stderr.
MCP: `opentext-mcp`, stdio JSON-RPC 2.0, protocol version "2025-06-18", tools `convert`, `extract_text`, `create_file`, `combine_pdfs`, `images_to_pdf`, `list_formats`, `lock_file`, `unlock_file` (password is a tool argument), each with a JSON Schema.

### OpenTextDesign + OpenTextUI (W2) — libraries, macOS 26, depend only on SwiftUI/AppKit/PDFKit
- `OpenTextDesign`: public `Brand.Palette` (values from design/brand.json, light/dark via NSColor dynamic provider), `Brand.Fonts` (Inter, registered from bundled resources with `Brand.registerFonts()`), radii/spacing/motion tokens, button styles (`.primaryAction` one per window, `.secondaryAction`, `.toolbarItem`), `FormatChip`, recessed/raised surface modifiers lit from top-left.
- `OpenTextUI` views take plain values and closures, never engine types:
  `PDFReaderView(document: PDFDocument, actions: PDFReaderActions)`, `ImageEditorView(image: NSImage, actions: ImageEditorActions)`, `TextEditorView(text: Binding<String>, isMarkdown: Bool, monospace: Bool, actions: TextEditorActions)` with fading toolbar, `QuickCreateView(state: Binding<QuickCreateState>, onCreate:)`, `SetupView(state:, actions:)`, `LockedFileView(fileName:, canUseTouchID:, onUnlock:)`, `ConvertSheet(sourceFormat: String, targets: [String], onConvert:)`, `RecoveryKeySheet(displayString:, onDone:)`. Format identifiers cross this boundary as lowercase extension strings ("pdf", "md").
- PDF page operations that don't need UI (reorder, delete, insert document, rotate, add highlight, stamp signature image) live in `OpenTextUI` as `PDFPageOps` with unit tests.
